title: 第2327章 姜玄烨第2326章 黑色珠子
slug: 刚穿越就继承了宗主之位
lines: “这是姜玄烨吗？”
一些眼尖的看到了姜玄烨身上的异状。
“他是不是被什么邪物附身了？”
众人不由地打了一个哆嗦。
“多少年了……”
姜玄烨，或者说此时他已经不是原来的那个姜玄烨了，他缓缓说了一句话，声音沙哑，又充满了阴冷。
“终于……还是让他出来了。”
半空中，白帝的脸色难看到了极点。
他死死盯着血光中的那道身影。
眼中既有愤怒，又有忌惮。
秦叶并没有再对白帝出手，他也在看血光中的姜玄烨，而且也认出了他。
他一眼就看出此时的姜玄烨已经被夺舍。
“姜玄烨”的修为虽然一直在快速的提升，但是他身上的气息却是充满了黑暗、阴冷，说明夺舍之人，十有八九是什么邪魔歪道。
“那是什么东西？”
秦叶朝着白帝，沉声问道。
白帝并没有回答秦叶的问题，而是脸色格外的凝重。
秦叶虽然不知道是什么夺舍了姜玄烨，但也能看出这个东西绝对不是什么好东西，或许白帝镇守在这里，就与这个东西有关。
就在这时，那些围观的武修，却是发现周围灵气都在朝着“姜玄烨”疯狂的涌去。
“不好！他在吞噬周围的灵力！”
一位武皇惊呼出声。
众人这才发现，以“姜玄烨”为中心，方圆百里的天地灵气正在疯狂地朝着他而去。
更为可怕的是，花草枯萎，山谷中的灵药都在被他吞噬。
“啊啊啊……我的身体……”
就在这时，接连有武修发出了惨叫声，只见他们的身上的血肉被吞噬，眨眼间只剩下了一具枯骨。
“这是邪门歪道！快退！”
当即有武皇强者当机立断，带着自己人迅速后退。
content_en:
"Is this Jiang Xuanye?"
Some sharp-eyed people saw something strange on Jiang Xuanye.
"Is he possessed by something evil?"
Everyone couldn't help but tremble.
"How many years have it been..."
Jiang Xuanye, or rather he was no longer the same Jiang Xuanye at this time, he spoke slowly, his voice was hoarse and full of coldness.
"Finally...let him come out."
In mid-air, Bai Di's expression turned extremely ugly.
He stared at the figure in the bloody light.
There was both anger and fear in his eyes.
Qin Ye did not take action against Bai Di again. He was also looking at Jiang Xuanye in the bloody light and recognized him.
He could tell at a glance that Jiang Xuanye had been taken away from him.
Although "Jiang Xuanye's" cultivation level has been improving rapidly, the aura on his body is full of darkness and coldness, indicating that the person who took the body is most likely some kind of evil devil.
"What is that?"
Qin Ye asked Bai Di in a deep voice.
Bai Di did not answer Qin Ye's question, but his face was extremely solemn.
Although Qin Ye didn't know what took away Jiang Xuanye's body, he could tell that this thing was definitely not a good thing. Maybe the reason why Bai Di was guarding here was related to this thing.
At this moment, the martial arts cultivators who were watching found that the spiritual energy around them was rushing towards "Jiang Xuanye" crazily.
"Not good! He is devouring the spiritual energy around him!"
A Martial Emperor exclaimed in surprise.
Only then did everyone realize that with "Jiang Xuanye" as the center, the spiritual energy of heaven and earth with a radius of hundreds of miles was heading towards him crazily.
What's even more terrifying is that the flowers and plants are withering, and all the elixirs in the valley are being devoured by him.
"Ahhh...my body..."
At this moment, martial arts cultivators screamed one after another, and saw their flesh and blood being devoured, leaving only a withered skeleton in the blink of an eye.
"This is a wicked way! Get back!"
Immediately, a strong Martial Emperor made a decisive decision and quickly retreated with his own people.
